source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: In your Command phase, any number of CHAOS KNIGHTS units in your army may each attempt a Malefic Surge. Each unit doing so first takes a Leadership test, suffering D3 mortal wounds if it fails; either way it then becomes Empowered until your next Command phase begins. An Empowered unit may use one Malefic Surge ability, and stops being Empowered once it has. Unholy Hunger: when one of its models makes a Normal move, an Advance move or a Fall Back move, its Move characteristic gains 3" for that phase. Diabolic Power: as it is picked to shoot or to fight, pick one ability, either [LETHAL HITS] or else [SUSTAINED HITS 1], and the weapons its models carry have it for the rest of the phase. Unnatural Fortitude: as it is picked as an attack's target, choose for the rest of the phase either a 5+ invulnerable save or Feel No Pain 6+ for its models. Marking Empowered units with tokens, and clearing unused ones as your Command phase starts, is suggested.

detail.designerNote: track Empowered units with tokens; remove unused tokens at the start of your Command phase
